stage1.impression: A legible exploded view of a milk-carton speaker with believable red gloss and birch interior, but the whole frame sits in a dull mid-grey with a heavy vignette, the white carton reads as two flat, near-equal light-grey planes and the black drivers sink into the grey. The parts float with no clear common axis or shadow, and the right half and the bottom are sparse, so it reads as a competent CAD-quality draft rather than a hero image.

blocking_9: The sweep reads as clean, neutral studio paper: [950,450,1150,600] at 155-170, no corner below 135, and dE <= 1 to a neutral grey (now 140, corners 117-118, a* +1.5 to +1.9).
The Whole white is neutral on both visible faces: dE <= 1.0 against a neutral grey at the same level on the side-left and the front baffle (now 2.9 to 3.4).
No lamp shows in the white lacquer: the low_fill rectangle (+12 levels, x 398-462, y 470-560) is gone from the side-left.
Every white part reads white against the sweep: the insert body at 195-215 (now 183) and the lower side-left at 199 or more (now 194), each at least 30 levels above the paper beside it.
The waveguide reads as a horn: inside the insert's red cap, a lit far wall at least 50 levels above the near wall (now p5-p95 59-87).

The build face is legible: the front baffle is seen about 67 degrees off-axis, so the woofer rebate is an 82 x 207 px slit, the trim rings are thin black ellipses and the tweeter dome is 8 px wide. A 9 turns the cabinet about 10 degrees toward the lens (rotate_z about 62) and lengthens all six explode distances about 15% so no part overlaps.
The plinth's accent red within dE 5 of #C62828 on its lit side (now 9.5, against 0.46 on the gable's front slope).

changes.problem: The whole set lives in a dull 116-143 mid-grey band, darker at the left and in the top-right corner, so the frame reads dim and murky rather than a clean studio sweep.
changes.expected: Paper albedo x1.38 in linear: [950,450,1150,600] about 162, left edge about 137, top-right about 138, frame mean about 150. The white cabinet keeps at least 28 levels over the paper beside it (front-baffle far edge [540,400,572,470] 193 against [580,420,640,500] going 139 -> about 162), and the black drivers (20-65) gain about 20 levels of separation.

changes.problem: Every neutral in the frame carries the same magenta-red shift (R 4-7 levels above G and B), so the Whole body's #FFFFFF renders pinkish.

evidence.measured: front-baffle pixels in this box: rgb (230,224,225), dE2000 3.09 vs neutral #E1E1E1 (a* +2.2, b* +0.2); side-left mid [330,380,390,460] (213,207,205), dE 2.89; backdrop [950,450,1150,600] (144,139,139), a* +1.85; insert white (183,183,187), a* +1.1. The same positive a* on every neutral points to the white point's tint, not one lamp.

changes.expected: R and B drop about 2% against G across the frame: front baffle about (226,225,225), dE <= 1; backdrop neutral (R = G = B within 1); insert white a* about -0.5; side-left left with only its warm b*, which c6 removes. Reds stay within dE 1 of #C62828 on the gable's front slope.

changes.problem: The low_fill panel's emitter shows in the side-left's clear coat as a hard-edged rectangle, +12 levels and cut off by the front corner: a stray window in the middle of the plain white face.

evidence.measured: x-profile 200.2, 200.2, 200.9, 204.2, 210.4, 211.6, 212.3, 212.3 (falloff -12.1). y-profile at x 400-455: 203 above y 470, 212 from y 470 to 550, 196 below y 565. Its size and height match the mirror image of the 0.6 x 0.25 m low_fill at [-0.245,-0.756,0.02], whose centre maps about 0.11 m past the front corner at z about 0.43 m (specular 0 does not keep it out of the clear coat).

changes.expected: The lamp moves 0.3 m parallel to the face toward the front corner, at the same distance from the face, with its target unchanged. Its mirror image lands about 0.1 m (about 45 px) beyond the corner, so the rectangle leaves the face, and the x-profile across [372,490,428,545] flattens to within 2 levels. The lower-face fill holds, because irradiance is kept at the same target.

changes.problem: The insert's white body sits at 183, below the 200-220 band where white lacquer reads white, and after c1 it would stand only about 20 levels above the paper behind it.

evidence.measured: waveguide-insert pixels in this box: lum_median 183.3 (p5 175.3, p95 189.3), rgb (183,183,187); the sweep behind it is 140 now and about 162 after c1

changes.expected: The insert's white side reaches about 200: it reads white, stands at least 35 levels above the lifted sweep, and stays below the cabinet's lit front (225). The red cap's diffuse level rises a few levels.

changes.problem: The waveguide bowl in the insert's red cap does not read as a recess: below the cap's sheen band the red is one flat value with a few wavy darker patches, and no lit far wall or rim describes the horn's depth.

evidence.measured: waveguide-insert pixels in this box: lum p5 58.8, median 78.8, p95 87.2. The 165-180 sheen band sits above, at y 280-300. Wavy 48-110 patches lie to the left at x 960-1010, y 295-345.

changes.expected: With the horn on its horizontal forward axis, the bowl's far (right-hand) wall at about a 45 degree flare mirrors the direction (0.87, -0.49, 0.10), where this panel sits. The far wall shows a graded pink-red crescent at lum about 130-165 while the near wall stays 55-80, so the horn reads concave. The cap's flat face mirrors the gloss panel behind-right, not this one, and the panel is light-linked and reflection-only, so nothing else changes. If the reading does not move, the far wall faces closer to the camera: swing the panel to about [1.5, -1.25, 1.95].

changes.problem: Where the 5600 K key grazes the top of the side-left, the white turns warm, while the front baffle, lit by the 6200 K fill, is neutral in b*: two whites of one finish.

evidence.measured: rgb (224,217,214), dE 3.36 vs #DADADA (a* +2.4, b* +1.95). b* falls down the face (+1.95 top, +1.72 mid, +1.24 low) as the key's share falls; front baffle b* +0.2.

changes.expected: With c2, the upper side-left goes to about (219,218,218), dE <= 1 vs neutral, matching the front baffle. The gable's left slope stays within dE 4 of #C62828 (now 3.7). If the engine needs more than about 7000 K to pass, the key is not the warm source.

changes.problem: The lower third of the side-left drops to 192-194, under the band where white lacquer reads white, and the red plinth below it renders dark, dE 9.5 from the accent.
changes.expected: The lower side-left reaches about 202. The face's top-to-bottom falloff eases from 28 to about 19 levels and is still modelled. The plinth side lifts to about (165,33,34), dE about 7. Apply after c3, so the brighter lamp is already outside the face's reflection.

out_of_scope.request: Turn the tweeter and the waveguide insert so the dome and the bowl's mouth face the lens
out_of_scope.why: Both are seen about 77 degrees off their forward fixing axis. That is why the dome is 8 px wide (tweeter-dome [751,242,759,260]) and the bowl's mouth is foreshortened to a sliver. Each part must stay on its own axis and the waveguide's shape is set by acoustic simulation, so only light (c5) and the cabinet's turn (blocking_9) can help.

out_of_scope.request: Larger or contrasting magnets and boss bore in the empty pocket
out_of_scope.why: The purpose asks for the pocket's bore and magnets to be visible. The magnets cover 33 px (magnets-pocket [439,170,446,198]) and the bore barely registers. Their size and finish are product geometry and materials, which are fixed.
